=== Identity and source limits ===
Benjamin is named with Mary in the 1818–1824 London baptism indexes; his own father remains Unknown. A newly inspected 1871 census index gives a 79-year-old widowed hawker named Benjamin Glasgow, born about 1792 in St Marylebone, but his identity with this father is unproved. The census contains no parent statement and no birthplace or birthday is adopted for this documentary account.

The 1871 census index lists a widowed 79-year-old hawker born at St Marylebone. His identification with the earlier father remains unresolved; the census does not name his parents.<ref>[https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VRJ9-5Z2 FamilySearch, England and Wales Census 1871, Benjamin Glasgow], index inspected 12 November 2026; original image uninspected.</ref>
